title: [Mortgage Plan] 1. Download 2–3 years of HMRC SA302s & Tax Year Overviews
notes: Log into HMRC Government Gateway (or ask accountant) to download the last 2–3 years of SA302 Tax Calculations and corresponding Tax Year Overviews showing ~£50k net profit. Ensure all tax payments are up to date.
ai_reasoning: Routine personal or administrative prep tasks average around 25-30 minutes.

title: [Mortgage Plan] 2. Gather 6 months of bank statements & ring-fence £80k savings
notes: Download the last 6 months of HSBC business and personal bank statements, plus proof of the £80,000 savings. Keep £75,000 ring-fenced for the deposit and £5,000 for solicitor/survey/purchase fees.
ai_reasoning: Detailed task description indicates multiple sub-steps (~45 mins).

title: [Mortgage Plan] 3. Check credit files & electoral roll registration
notes: Check Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion credit reports. Ensure electoral roll registration is current and all personal/business credit commitments are accurate.
ai_reasoning: Short communication, parcel pickup, or quick routine typically takes 15-20 minutes.

title: [Mortgage Plan] 4. Book consultation with HSBC & whole-of-market mortgage broker
notes: Speak with an HSBC Mortgage Advisor and an independent whole-of-market self-employed mortgage broker to compare rates at 65%–70% LTV (borrowing £125k–£175k on £50k declared profit).
ai_reasoning: Short communication, parcel pickup, or quick routine typically takes 15-20 minutes.

title: [Mortgage Plan] 5. Secure Decision in Principle (AIP) for £175k loan
notes: Submit soft-credit check application to get an official AIP certificate for up to £175,000 mortgage (covering up to a £250,000 flat with £75,000 deposit). Required before viewing/offering in London.
ai_reasoning: Short communication, parcel pickup, or quick routine typically takes 15-20 minutes.

title: [Mortgage Plan] 6. Shortlist & get quotes from leasehold conveyancing solicitors
notes: Obtain quotes from 2–3 leasehold-experienced property solicitors so you can instruct them immediately once an offer is accepted.
ai_reasoning: Detailed task description indicates multiple sub-steps (~45 mins).

title: [Mortgage Plan] 7. View flats in Lewisham & vet lease length / service charges
notes: View £200k–£250k flats (Lewisham, Hither Green, Catford, Ladywell). Verify remaining lease is 85+ years (ideally 100+), check annual service charges/ground rent, and confirm standard construction (avoid high-rise deck-access concrete towers).
ai_reasoning: Short communication, parcel pickup, or quick routine typically takes 15-20 minutes.

title: [Mortgage Plan] 8. Make offer with AIP & proof of deposit
notes: Submit formal offer to the estate agent alongside your AIP certificate and proof of £75k deposit. Once accepted, request the Memorandum of Sale.
ai_reasoning: Detailed task description indicates multiple sub-steps (~45 mins).

title: [Mortgage Plan] 11. Receive Mortgage Offer, Exchange Contracts & Complete
notes: Receive Formal Mortgage Offer, review the solicitor's Leasehold Report, transfer the £75,000 deposit to your solicitor's client account, exchange contracts, and complete to get the keys.
ai_reasoning: Technical review, debugging, or sprint planning requires ~45 minutes of focused context.

title: [Mortgage Plan] 10. Complete lender valuation & book RICS Level 2 survey
notes: Lender conducts mortgage valuation. Book an independent RICS Level 2 HomeBuyer Report (or Level 3 survey) to inspect the property's condition.
ai_reasoning: Short communication, parcel pickup, or quick routine typically takes 15-20 minutes.

title: [Mortgage Plan] 9. Instruct solicitor & submit full mortgage application
notes: Instruct your chosen solicitor and submit the full mortgage application to the lender with your SA302s, Tax Year Overviews, bank statements, and property details.
ai_reasoning: Routine personal or administrative prep tasks average around 25-30 minutes.
